name: Textbook: field into the page
summary: B points into the page. The bar slides to the right.

name: Reverse the field
summary: B points out of the page. The current direction flips.

name: Reverse the motion
summary: The same field, with the bar sliding to the left.

name: Motion parallel to B
summary: The field points along the rails, so the bar does not cut field lines.

name: Open circuit
summary: The bar still cuts field lines, but the circuit is open, so no current flows.

name: Stronger field, longer bar
summary: A larger B and a longer conductor give a larger e.m.f. at the same speed.
